title: eleutherococcus seoulensis
intro: Eleutherococcus seoulensis, commonly known as the Korean ginseng or Seoul ginseng, is a perennial plant species in the family Araliaceae. It is an adaptogenic herb that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-stress properties. The therapeutic actions of Eleutherococcus seoulensis include enhancing physical performance, improving immune function, and reducing fatigue. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often extracted and used in herbal supplements.
